content.whatYouDo: I run a YouTube channel about cooking on a budget. I post 2 videos per week — one recipe walkthrough and one 'meal prep for the week' format.
content.whoYouServe: College students and young professionals aged 18-28 who want to eat well without spending a lot. Most have limited kitchen equipment.
content.keyDetails: Videos are 8-12 minutes long. I film with a single camera, overhead angle. Tone is upbeat and encouraging. I avoid complex techniques.

business.whatYouDo: I run a SaaS startup offering project management tools for remote teams. We're pre-Series A with 500 active users.
business.whoYouServe: Small business owners and team leads managing 5-20 remote employees who need simple, affordable collaboration tools.
business.keyDetails: We use a freemium model. Main competitors are Asana and Monday.com. Our differentiator is AI-powered task prioritization.

technical.whatYouDo: I lead backend development at a fintech startup. We process payment transactions and handle regulatory compliance.
technical.whoYouServe: Our internal dev team of 8 engineers, mostly mid-level. We also support QA and product teams.
technical.keyDetails: Stack: Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS. We deploy weekly via CI/CD. PCI-DSS compliance is mandatory.

writing.whatYouDo: I am a freelance copywriter specializing in health and wellness.
writing.whoYouServe: Direct-to-consumer (DTC) supplement brands and holistic health practitioners.
writing.keyDetails: Focus on science-backed claims with an approachable, engaging tone. Adherence to FDA guidelines is strictly required.

marketing.whatYouDo: I manage digital marketing for a mid-sized e-commerce store selling sustainable apparel.
marketing.whoYouServe: Eco-conscious millennials and Gen Z consumers looking for affordable, ethically made clothing.
marketing.keyDetails: Main channels are Instagram and TikTok. We emphasize transparency, eco-friendly materials, and body positivity.

education.whatYouDo: I am a high school science teacher teaching Biology and Chemistry.
education.whoYouServe: 10th and 11th-grade students, ranging from general education to Advanced Placement (AP) levels.
education.keyDetails: I focus on inquiry-based learning and hands-on experiments. I need materials that are engaging and align with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).

design.whatYouDo: I am a UX/UI designer at an agency, working on mobile apps for healthcare clients.
design.whoYouServe: Patients managing chronic conditions, typically older adults (55+).
design.keyDetails: Accessibility is critical (high contrast, large tap targets). The aesthetic should be clean, calming, and trustworthy.

custom.whatYouDo: I am a professional working on various projects across different domains.
custom.whoYouServe: A diverse range of clients and stakeholders depending on the specific project.
custom.keyDetails: I need flexibility to adapt my approach and outputs based on the current task requirements.
